description: This file implements remote cluster pinging and connection management for Mattermost, including functions for immediate ping, periodic ping loops, handling ping responses, and event firing on connection state changes.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Service class managing remote cluster pings and connection states.

methods.name: PingNow
methods.description: Immediately pings a specific remote cluster and updates connection state.

methods.name: pingAllNow
methods.description: Pings all remote clusters matching a filter immediately.

methods.name: pingLoop
methods.description: Runs a periodic loop to ping all remote clusters.

methods.name: pingGenerator
methods.description: Generates ping requests at a set frequency.

methods.name: pingEmitter
methods.description: Emits ping requests to remote clusters from a channel.

methods.name: pingRemote
methods.description: Performs a synchronous ping to a remote cluster, handling plugin and HTTP pings.

methods.name: makePingFrame
methods.description: Creates a ping message frame for a remote cluster.

methods.name: fireConnectionStateChgEvent
methods.description: Fires an event when a remote cluster's connection state changes.
